title: Design System: Zack Murphy Academic Portfolio

display.purpose: The restrained home-page research statement, balanced against the profile panel and introductory copy.

body.purpose: Long-form academic prose and metadata, rendered in Segoe UI.

motion.name: state-only
motion.purpose: No decorative motion; state changes remain immediate.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A high-contrast action used only when a page needs a dominant control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #6eb7ff; border-radius: 6px; background: #6eb7ff; color: #07111f; font: 600 0.96rem/1.5 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #ffd166; background: #ffd166; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quieter action with a clear boundary and the same target size.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #6eb7ff; border-radius: 6px; background: #07111f; color: #6eb7ff; font: 600 0.96rem/1.5 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #ffd166; color: #ffd166; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: A quiet flight-deck header with readable targets and explicit focus.
components.html: Zack MurphyResearchPublications
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #506c86; background: #07111f; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: #f5f7fa; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-title { margin-right: auto; font: 650 1.15rem/1.2 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link { font: 500 0.96rem/1.5 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #ffd166; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { border-radius: 3px; outline: 3px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: A selected-work navigation tile whose full surface is a single accessible link target.
components.html:
Research →

Short summaries of current research and ongoing projects.
components.css: .ds-feature { position: relative; display: block; max-width: 320px; min-height: 210px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #506c86; border-radius: 8px; background: #0e2034; color: #f5f7fa; font: 400 1.03rem/1.68 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-feature h3 { margin-top: 0; padding-right: 42px; color: #f5f7fa; font: 650 1.55rem/1.2 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-feature span { position: absolute; top: 17px; right: 20px; color: #6eb7ff; } .ds-feature:hover { border-color: #ffd166; background: #122944; color: #f5f7fa; } .ds-feature:hover h3, .ds-feature:hover span { color: #ffd166; } .ds-feature:focus-visible { border-color: #ffd166; outline: 3px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hero Profile Panel
components.description: The single elevated surface that groups current interests and professional links.

components.name: Inline Code
components.description: A readable treatment for file extensions and literal technical identifiers.
components.css: .ds-code-line { color: #f5f7fa; font: 400 1.03rem/1.68 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-inline-code { padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: #0e2034; color: #6eb7ff; font-family: Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-inline-code:hover { color: #ffd166; } .ds-inline-code:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
This system frames an academic portfolio as a calm view from a flight deck: dark, focused, and information-first. Space-flight color provides identity, while generous line height, bright text, and a familiar serif-and-sans pairing keep research content effortless to read.

The visual language is modern, sleek, and intentional without copying NASA marks or implying NASA endorsement. It rejects generic SaaS aesthetics, institutional university templates, dashboard styling, ornamental editorial treatments, excessive cards and dividers, low-contrast minimalism, and decorative motion that competes with the academic content.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy surfaces with decisive light-on-dark contrast.
Serif academic authority paired with a highly readable system sans.
Vibrant accents used as signals, never decoration without purpose.
Precise spacing, restrained ambient depth, and visible keyboard focus.
Static composition and responsive reflow rather than decorative motion.

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Orbital Blue communicates interaction, Signal Red communicates rare emphasis, and Solar Gold communicates focus; never exchange those roles for decoration.

rules.name: The Contrast Before Color Rule
rules.body: Every functional color pair must meet WCAG 2.2 AA before it enters the stylesheet.

rules.name: The Continuous Field Rule
rules.body: Ambient color glows must span the page with same-hue alpha fades and explicit no-repeat behavior. Only the star field may tile, preventing visible bands where Orbital Blue, Signal Red, and Deep Space meet.

rules.name: The Constellation Rule
rules.body: The star field uses irregular positions, varied brightness and scale, and occasional restrained four-point stars. No repeated row, column, or spacing interval should be visually dominant.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Body copy always receives more breathing room on a dark surface; never compress line height to create artificial density.

rules.name: The One Display Moment Rule
rules.body: The prominent serif display belongs to the home-page research statement, but it must remain balanced with the profile panel and introductory copy at every viewport width.

rules.name: The Ambient Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows must be broad, dark, and quiet; never use a sharp shadow to simulate a clickable card.

dos: Do keep the Creative North Star, "Easy to read academic portfolio," ahead of decorative ambition.
Do use Starlight for primary text and Lunar Gray only for secondary text on Deep Space or Flight Deck.
Do reserve Solar Gold for focus and hover orientation so keyboard position is unmistakable.
Do keep every required text contrast at 4.5:1 or higher and essential non-text contrast at 3:1 or higher.
Do preserve semantic headings, descriptive alternative text, responsive reflow, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't use excessive cards and dividers.
Don't use decorative motion that competes with the academic content.
Don't use NASA insignia, logotype, identifiers, or any treatment that implies NASA endorsement.
Don't use a colored side stripe wider than 1px as a substitute for hierarchy.
